title: 明确崩溃日志：存在异常与 Caused by

player_issue.text: Game crashes every time I break the custom door from this mod. Single-player, NeoForge 1.21.1. I attached the crash log.

summary.issue_title: Client crashes when breaking a custom door
summary.symptoms: The client crashes to desktop when a custom door block is broken.
reproduction_steps: Enter a single-player world with the mod installed.
Break the door with any tool.
summary.current_assessment: The log contains a NullPointerException in the mod's DoorBlock.onRemove; the exact trigger is not confirmed.
summary.disclaimer: This report only organizes information present in the log; it does not confirm a root cause.
